value.rationale: The question tests the permanence of effective stationary Fourier reconstruction under a natural exponentially sparse measurement schedule. It yields a complete, sharp arithmetic criterion, an exact a.e. rate, a comeagre yet dimension-zero set with maximal rate oscillation, and all attainable unbalanced rates among convergent cases. These are interpretable stability properties of a motivated sampling system, not an arbitrary finite calculation.
